traits.name: Fur
traits.description: Thick woolly fur grants +1 AC when unarmoured or wearing Light armour.

traits.name: Gaze (Longhorn, Level 4+)
traits.description: Can charm humans and shorthorns into obeisance. Target Saves vs Spell or is charmed. Duration until next sunrise. Usage by level: L4-5: 1/day, L6-7: 2/day, L8-9: 3/day, L10+: 4/day.

traits.name: Horns
traits.description: Melee horn attack. Damage and length scale by level. L1: 1d4, L3: 1d4+1, L6: 1d6, L9: 1d6+1, L10+: 1d6+2.

classRestrictions.notes: Seldom clerics or friars. Rare enchanters.

traits.name: Elf Skills
traits.description: Skill Target 5 for Listen and Search.

traits.name: Glamours
traits.description: Knows one randomly determined glamour.

traits.name: Immortality
traits.description: Cannot die naturally. Immune to non-magical diseases. Cannot die of thirst/starvation (but becomes desperate/sadistic).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: +2 Magic Resistance.

traits.name: Unearthly Beauty
traits.description: +2 Charisma (max 18) when interacting with mortals.

traits.name: Vulnerable to Cold Iron
traits.description: Cold iron weapons inflict +1 damage.

classRestrictions.notes: Cannot be cleric or friar (no spiritual connection with mortal deities). Rarely accepted as knight.

traits.name: Armour and Weapons
traits.description: Armour tailored to small size. Cannot wield Large weapons.

traits.name: Defensive Bonus
traits.description: +2 AC in melee with Large creatures.

traits.name: Eating Giant Rodents
traits.description: After 1 Turn devouring a freshly killed giant rodent, heals 1 HP.

traits.name: Decisiveness
traits.description: When Initiative is tied, humans act first.

traits.name: Leadership
traits.description: Loyalty of retainers increased by 1.

traits.name: Spirited
traits.description: +10% bonus to all XP earned (in addition to Prime Ability XP bonus).

classRestrictions.notes: Can be any class. Rarely enchanters (rare connection to Fairy).

traits.name: Armour and Weapons
traits.description: Armour tailored to small size. Cannot wield Large weapons. Prefer non-metal armour (bark, pinecone).

traits.name: Knacks
traits.description: Each mossling knows one knack (quasi-magical craft). See Mossling Knacks (p112).

traits.name: Mossling Skills
traits.description: Skill Target 5 for Survival when foraging.

traits.name: Resilience
traits.description: +4 Save vs fungal spores or poisons. +2 to all other Saving Throws.

traits.name: Symbiotic Flesh
traits.description: At each Level (incl. Level 1), gains a random trait from the Symbiotic Flesh table (d20).

classRestrictions.notes: Seldom clerics or friars. Rarely accepted as knights. Very rarely enchanters.

traits.name: Compulsive Jubilation
traits.description: Must partake in any witnessed party/feast/celebration. Save vs Spell to resist (at cost).

traits.name: Mad Revelry
traits.description: 1/day: play enchanted melody on wind instrument to afflict nearby creatures (Save vs Spell). Options: Confide, Dance, Imbibe, Jape, Jubilate, Mount, Revel.

traits.name: Moon Sight
traits.description: Darkvision 60'. Views darkness as if in faint moonlight.

traits.name: Musical Instrument
